name: Employee Balances
query:
select employee 'Employee:Link/Employee:100', employee_name 'Name:Data:180', company 'Company:Link/Company:240', status 'Status:Data:100',
SUM(CASE
  WHEN account = 'Leave Salary' THEN balance ELSE 0 END
) 'Leave Salary:Float:120',
SUM(CASE
  WHEN account = 'Air Ticket' THEN balance ELSE 0 END
) 'Air Ticket:Float:120',
SUM(CASE
  WHEN account = 'EOSB' THEN balance ELSE 0 END
) 'EOSB:Float:120',
SUM(CASE
  WHEN account = 'Annual Leave' THEN balance ELSE 0 END
) 'Annual Leave:Float:120',
SUM(CASE
  WHEN account = 'Sick Leave' THEN balance ELSE 0 END
) 'Sick Leave:Float:120'
from
(
select e.name employee, e.employee_name, e.company, e.status, ifnull(l.ac,'') account, round(ifnull(l.balance,0),2) balance
from `tabEmployee` e
left join 
(
select if(account='2020101001 - Airticket Payable - NE', 'Air Ticket', 
	if(account='2020101002 - EOSB Payable - NE', 'EOSB', 
    if(account='2020101004 - Leave Salary Payable - NE', 'Leave Salary', 'Other'))) ac, 
party, round(sum(credit_in_account_currency - debit_in_account_currency),2) balance from `tabGL Entry` 
where party_type = 'Employee'
and account in
(
#'2010104002 - Employee Expense Claims - NE',
'2020101001 - Airticket Payable - NE',
'2020101002 - EOSB Payable - NE',
'2020101004 - Leave Salary Payable - NE'
)
and is_cancelled = 0
and posting_date <= %(posting_date)s
group by account, party
) l on e.name = l.party
union
select e.name employee, e.employee_name, e.company, e.status, ifnull(l2.leave_type,'') account, round(ifnull(l2.available_leave,0),2) balance
from `tabEmployee` e
left join 
(
select employee, leave_type, sum(leaves) available_leave from `tabLeave Ledger Entry` 
where leave_type in ('Annual Leave','Sick Leave') and 
docstatus = 1 and 
creation <= %(posting_date)s
group by employee, leave_type
) l2 on e.name = l2.employee
order by employee
) s
group by employee
;
